verdict.rationale: vLLM documents a CLI command that starts an OpenAI-compatible API server, plus an official Docker image for running that server. That makes it a network-serving engine, but the evidence never explicitly documents binding to a LAN interface or reaching the server from other devices. Missing for 10: documented host/port binding options for LAN exposure, explicit guidance on access from other devices, and hands-on corroboration of cross-device LAN use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
OpenAI-compatible API server, plus Anthropic Messages API and gRPC support
vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
